problem_or_opportunity: A durable checkpoint can prove where work stopped, but safe recovery also requires multi-store write reconciliation, idempotency, checkpoint lineage/retention, and measured interruption evidence. Run32 additionally exposed that a candidate ID selected from partial visibility can collide with the full registry family.
proposed_mechanism: Extend 18C with a project-neutral durable transaction reconciler, explicit external-side-effect states, checkpoint lineage/retention ledger, interruption-learning evidence summarizer, and full registry-family ID freshness before candidate registration. Fail-closed order is blocker -> authority/state drift -> failed action -> identity/effect reconciliation -> safe missing actions -> exact completion.
expected_benefit: Prevents duplicate GitHub/Drive/provider work after interruption, quarantines ambiguous paid/irreversible side effects, preserves checkpoint lineage without transcript bloat, and gives Self-Improvement measurable recovery evidence instead of anecdotal claims.

protected_invariants: No automatic replay of paid or irreversible effects
acceptance_conditions: Full registry family has unique candidate IDs
Controlled reversible partial-write recovery passes without duplicate replay
Genuine interruption evidence still required before promotion review
development_contract.rollback: Remove SI-0014 Run33 modules/protocol references and retain merged 18C; do not roll back unrelated registry transaction, project-state, audio or story authorities.
